description: PLUSGOLF Ball Stroke settlement (spec V2 3I/5L/5M/5J). Per hole and pair: transfer = stroke difference + winner-only bonus (birdie +1, eagle +3, albatross/hole-in-one +5 by default; ties pay 0). Give players with per-hole 'scores' plus 'pars', or with round 'total' only (totals mode: pure stroke difference, no bonus). With apply_balance_cap=true, each player's payments are capped by their balance (default 36 balls) and shortfalls are split proportionally by calculated obligation (largest remaind

bonus.description: Winner bonus balls {birdie, eagle, albatross}; defaults 1/3/5.

pars.description: Hole pars, same length as scores (not needed in totals mode).
